status: pilot — asks are question-driven; only the [2b] gate is mandatory (design §12; the non-worse next-10 vs last-10 run comparison by lane still measures the pilot)
replyDir: $HOME/.nears/advisors/replies/<qid>.md — conductor-written (advisors hold no Write), never committed
scripts: scripts/advisors/up.sh <name> (relaunch a missing advisor, once, else skip) · scripts/advisors/owner-queue.sh (the two owner queues)
asker: the conductor only — no phase agent holds SendMessage/ListAgents; a phase agent raises NEEDS_DECISION{question, options, recommendation, domain} and never waits
consultPoints: (1) a NEEDS_DECISION{question, options, recommendation, domain} from ANY phase agent — the conductor classifies the tier (design §10) and routes a Tier A/B item to the roster advisor named by domain; Tier C parks
(3) ad hoc — when the conductor holds a domain question it would otherwise put to the owner
nothing else asks: no pre-doc TL consult, no engineer-packet round-trip, no pre-QA scope review (NEARS-3200)
why: advisors answer questions the workflow would otherwise put to the owner; they are not a review step
runFileKey: consults[] — TOP LEVEL, alongside fix_in_run[]/decisions[]/trail[]/sessions{}, never inside phases{}: design §9 field set verbatim {qid, advisor, phase, sent_epoch, received_epoch, elapsed_s, path, spot_check, timeout} plus an optional question (elapsed_s = integer received_epoch - sent_epoch, null when unanswered); conductor-written; run files without it stay valid
packetField: decisions_already_made (existing) carries NEEDS_DECISION answers; no advisor-specific field
envelopeField: NEEDS_DECISION{question, options, recommendation, domain} — domain routes to the roster advisor; no agent asks or waits
budget: 900 s per question, 1200 s at [8] (measured basis: scripts/newtask-guards/advisor-latency.sh); timeout -> drift[] advisor_timeout{qid, advisor}; skip -> trail[] advisor_skipped{phase, reason}; never wait past the budget — EXCEPT tier gates ([2b], run-sprint [3]), which are fail-closed: retry once, then an interactive owner ask, never a proceed
tiers: rule R14 — the table lives in new-task.md §Advisors; items in design §10 by reference
blockedStatus: Blocked (Jira status BLOCKED, id 10044) — the Tier C park; listed on the profile's Statuses line
note: Additive only: no node added, renamed or removed; the monitor ingests unknown top-level run-file keys additively. Canonical prose: new-task.md §Advisors.
